name: Deckhand Ruaraidh

intro.text: I do the ropes on the Skye boat. Up, down, up, down, nine times a day. A battle's the most exciting thing to happen since Tuesday.

win: Aye, you've sea legs. Ropes next?
after: On a rough crossing the whole boat is a bit green. The crew do not look green, because we are professionals and also not looking at the same time.
